consents_subject_ck.name: consents_subject_ck
consents_subject_ck.value: ("core"."consents"."subject_type" = 'user' and "core"."consents"."user_id" is not null) or ("core"."consents"."subject_type" = 'organization' and "core"."consents"."user_id" is null)

invitations_single_outcome_ck.name: invitations_single_outcome_ck
invitations_single_outcome_ck.value: not ("core"."invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "core"."invitations"."revoked_at" is not null)

approvals_decided_ck.name: approvals_decided_ck
approvals_decided_ck.value: ("agents"."approvals"."decision" = 'pending') = ("agents"."approvals"."decided_at" is null) and ("agents"."approvals"."decision" in ('pending', 'expired') or "agents"."approvals"."decided_by_subject_id" is not null)

artifacts_location_ck.name: artifacts_location_ck
artifacts_location_ck.value: ("content"."artifacts"."storage_key" is not null) <> ("content"."artifacts"."external_url" is not null)

uploads_clean_ck.name: uploads_clean_ck
uploads_clean_ck.value: ("core"."uploads"."status" = 'clean') = ("core"."uploads"."clean_key" is not null) and ("core"."uploads"."status" <> 'clean' or "core"."uploads"."sha256" is not null)
